scientific_integrity: Cumulant formulas are independently reconstructed from stationarity of the joint Markov generator; uniqueness and feasible range proved algebraically. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only exact stationary population cumulants with known trap-relaxation rate. No claims about measurement noise or finite-sample precision.
Does not extend to asymmetric headings, non-Poisson flip clocks, finite resting stages, or nonlinear confinement.
Forward beta/Gaussian stationary laws and moment formulas are prior literature, not new contributions.
Independent assessment of full publication priority has not been performed.
title: Three-cumulant inversion and a sharp realizability region for thermal telegraph confinement
